technology_name: Bio Filter Technology for Industrial Odour Control
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Bio Filter Technology for Industrial Odour Control
description: This biofilter technology is designed for the treatment of odorous gaseous streams generated by industrial activities. The system uses specially selected microorganisms and supporting materials to neutralize pollutants and reduce airborne contaminants. It has been implemented in industrial applications and is intended for long-term odour management and environmental improvement.
applications:
Wastewater treatment plants and solid waste management facilities
Food processing, rendering, and agro-based industries
Chemical, pharmaceutical, and industrial manufacturing units
Municipal corporations and environmental management agencies
Industrial parks and pollution control infrastructure projects
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Water, Environment & Waste Management
